source: pre-Phase 3 daemon stream proxy, relay client, and hosted stream Rust behaviour
normalization: stream proxy response bytes and upstream request bytes are compared literally after normalization
disconnect cases compare whether the upstream socket observes EOF rather than retaining a leaked connection
relay websocket frames are parsed as JSON and sorted to stable key order before comparison
hosted stream temp roots, tokens, principal ids and audit timestamps are normalized

cases.name: hosted-non-stream-proxy-client-reset-is-close
cases.catches: Asserting intended behavior pending the production fix: a downstream client reset during a non-stream hosted proxy response is handled as connection close after the response begins, not as a proxy success lie or handler crash.
